sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.
Dear Mr Brandlhuber, thank you for your letter and for the many years of reliable partnership. We have not forgotten how you stood by us in the last crisis. We understand that labour and steel have become dearer, and we want a fair solution that keeps the casing healthy for you. As our agreement sets prices per calendar year, we propose to adjust from the new year, and we share the official index figures we used.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. We appreciate your constructive response and the offer of 14-day payment terms, which we gladly accept. 

In recognition of our long-standing partnership, the contractual notice period, and your increased volume forecast, we agree to an effective date of 1 January 2027. Taking into account the verified reduction in energy costs, we propose a revised price of €134.30 per unit to ensure the continued high quality of our castings, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the quality record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We checked the quality data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our updated offer stands at a price of €131.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

decisions.why: at the price that is cheapest for us with the relationship charge; C 1,103,187 below the limit 1,153,780

key_points: Stabilise case on a sole-source part priced at or slightly below full cost: aim for a modest, cost-justified increase, not a cut.
Contract fixes prices per calendar year with ninety days' notice, so the November start is invalid. Anchor on the new year as a contractual effective date.
Checkable drivers: labour up and steel up, power down over twelve months. Weighted, they support only a small single-digit increase, far below the asked one.
Our main trade is short payment (fourteen days) for this cash-seeking supplier, kept for the closing step. Contract length and volume are fixed in this case.
Only one part is in this case, so no bundling with the larger casing is possible here. The evidence for further downward room on this part is thin.
Never cite the rival quote, the should-cost, peak-based indices, price history in its favour, or our payment behaviour.
plan.stance_why: Strategic sole source, priced at or below full cost, with a margin charge and dearer fallback. Open moderately below the ask, close to a fair index-based increase from the new year.

levers.why: Checkable; justifies moving the start to the new calendar year without conflict.

argument.sentence: Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
argument.note: Letter of 2026-09-11 asks 9.5% (EUR 138.55) from 2026-11-01 with 51 days' notice; clause ctr:4600070110#3.1 needs 90. Too short: the change cannot take effect as asked. The clause fixes prices per calendar year, and the letter asks for a change within it.

levers.why: Power fell over twelve months while the letter cites energy; checkable and reduces the justified increase.

argument.sentence: Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
argument.note: PPI-D351 (Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution): -3.7% 12 months (2025-08 to 2026-08); 6% of the part's cost, so about -0.22% on the price.

levers.why: Higher forecast spreads fixed costs; checkable and appeals to its volume need.

argument.sentence: Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09).
argument.note: Snapshot 2026-09: 8150 for the next 12 months against 7400 ordered in the last 12 months (requested dates); shared with suppliers: True. More volume is worth more to it.

levers.why: A fresh fact for a later round, stated calmly; weak quality argues against a full increase.

argument.sentence: Our recent quality notifications on this part average 4117 ppm (qn:20004978, qn:20004934, qn:20004877, qn:20004853, qn:20004837, qn:20004728).
argument.note: 6 supplier-caused complaints on this part in the last 12 months (dimension out of tolerance, missing marking, surface damage, wrong material certificate); EUR 600 recharged; 1 without a closed 8D. Per-lot ppm is jumpy (KNOWN_ISSUES 10): the scorecard's rolling ppm is the fairer figure.

levers.why: Late filler fact; on-time delivery is below target.

argument.sentence: Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).
argument.note: Rolling 12 months to 2026-09-30: 85.2% on time against the requested date (88.9% against its own confirmed date); target 95%; peers' median 84.6%; class B amber. A year earlier 88.2%.

levers.why: Confirms the current price basis if disputed.

argument.sentence: Our latest orders for this part were all at EUR 126.53 per unit (po:4500014428-10, po:4500014358-10, po:4500014313-10).
argument.note: What we pay now: [126.53, 126.53, 126.53] per unit (2026-08-24 to 2026-09-21); anchors any increase.

trades.why: The contract only allows price changes per calendar year with ninety days' notice, so the new year is the earliest valid date.
It asked for fast payment; fourteen days costs us little interest and buys the final price step.
An intermediate step if it presses for payment before the close.

sup:70110.opening_paragraph: Dear Mr Brandlhuber, thank you for your letter and for the many years of reliable partnership. We have not forgotten how you stood by us in the last crisis. We understand that labour and steel have become dearer, and we want a fair solution that keeps the casing healthy for you. As our agreement sets prices per calendar year, we propose to adjust from the new year, and we share the official index figures we used.
watch_for: Claims that steel rose and is a large cost share: concede steel openly, then show the weighted total including power.
Its payment request: answer it explicitly, and do not give fourteen days before the final step.
A declared final offer: accept it if it is below the fallback cost.
Insistence on the November start: answer kindly with the calendar-year clause.
Any hint of capacity or delivery strain if the price stays low: margin risk on a sole source.

risks: Pushing below full cost could worsen delivery and quality, or lose the sole source; the margin charge penalises this.
Payment-discipline complaints if fast payment is promised and then not kept.
The renewal notice window is close; do not bluff an exit.
Volume and contract length are fixed in this case, so the trades available to offset the price are few.
